description: AgentBench digital-games style: an unbeatable tic-tac-toe move selector with a depth-aware optimality rule (fastest win, slowest loss) so every test position has exactly one correct answer - win-now, blocking, fork creation, fork blocking, double-threat setup and the opening center.

criteria: All six positions answered with the unique depth-optimal move; a real search (or equivalent reasoning) rather than a lookup table for the test boards; tests and engine untouched.
